news.title: GoSpooky-oprichter Tim van der Wiel (28): 'Ik moet gewoon veel tijd doorbrengen met de jongere generatie'

summary: GoSpooky. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

insights.one_liner: GoSpooky is an Amsterdam social media agency growing brands through content, community and commerce; an IND sponsor with an English-language HR internship.

culture.text: Calls itself a global agency made for the social era, focused on content, community and commerce.
Team ranges from creatives and commerce specialists to game designers and data analysts, aiming for fast, bold work.

open.text: GoSpooky B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one current job here, an HR internship in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.

worth_knowing.text: Founder Tim van der Wiel, 28, says he needs to spend a lot of time with the younger generation.
